summary: Iteration 47 — Frontend-only verification of the new Vendor Dashboard Alert History + Sound Settings features and the new IslandHop logo, per review request. Logged in via /login form as the seeded grocery merchant merch_1784954600@gmail.com (httpOnly cookie flow) and reached /vendor-dashboard. LOGO: All three surfaces load the new mark cleanly — /login (AuthPage) shows islandhop-logo.png (naturalWidth=1920, complete=true) and islandhop-mark.png; the top-left header (SubAppsDropdown) shows islandhop-mark.png (nw=512, complete=true, alt='IslandHop'); the site footer shows islandhop-mark.png (nw=512, complete=true). Zero broken-image icons. ALERT HISTORY: vendor-alerts-toggle renders in the header with an unseen-count badge showing '2' (data-testid vendor-alerts-unseen-count). Clicking it opens vendor-alerts-panel; 2 alert items render with data-testid vendor-alert-item-<orderId>, each showing 'New order #<id> · <service>', relative time ('31m ago', '39m ago'), amount ($21.00 / $71.00) and status ('pending'). vendor-alerts-mark-seen control works — after click the vendor-alerts-unseen-count badge is removed (count 1→0). Empty state (vendor-alerts-empty) is correctly NOT shown when orders exist. SOUND SETTINGS: vendor-sound-settings-btn opens vendor-sound-settings-dialog. All required controls present: vendor-sound-settings-toggle (On/Off), vendor-sound-chime-select (all 5 option testids present: classic/ding/bell/marimba/urgent), vendor-sound-volume-slider, vendor-sound-volume-value (shows '70%'), and vendor-sound-test-btn (clickable, no error). Changing chime from 'Classic' to 'Bell' persists to localStorage key vendor_sound_chime='bell'. Test sound button executes without JS errors. REGRESSION: vendor-sound-toggle (1), weekly-payout-card (1), Storefront + Grow dropdown buttons all render; orders tabs Pending(2)/Active(2)/Preparing(0)/Ready(0)/Completed(0) render correctly under the Orders card. ZERO uncaught console errors after login (the initial two 401s pre-login are from the auth guard probing /api/auth/me before the cookie is set — expected). Overall: feature suite is working end-to-end; only two minor observations reported below.

ui_bugs.issue: The unseen-count badge correctly shows '2' unseen orders, but the per-item red-dot indicator (span.bg-red-500 rendered when `unseen` is true, VendorDashboard.js line 471) did not appear in the DOM for either alert item when the panel was first opened. Per the code, `unseen = alertsSeenAt ? String(o.created_at||'') > alertsSeenAt : true` should be `true` when alertsSeenAt is null (which also matches the badge count fallback `unseenAlertCount = alertsSeenAt ? filter : orders.length` == 2). The two counters agree that both orders are unseen, so both items should show a red dot — they do not. Possible bug in the per-item render (or `alertsSeenAt` is being seeded to a value that's still less than order created_at, but not null, breaking equality of the two computations). Impact: LOW — Mark-all-seen and header badge still communicate the same info.

integration_issues.issue: Radix Slider thumb did not respond to ArrowLeft when the slider element was focused via .focus() — volume % value stayed at '70%' after 5 ArrowLeft presses and localStorage vendor_sound_volume remained null. This is likely a test-harness limitation (Radix requires focus on the [role='slider'] thumb, not the wrapper) rather than a real bug, but worth confirming manually that dragging the slider in a real browser updates the % display AND writes to localStorage — otherwise saveSoundVolume never fires. The Chime select persists correctly (vendor_sound_chime='bell'), Test button fires with no errors, and the % value is visibly shown as '70%'.

action_items: Investigate why the per-item red-dot span (VendorDashboard.js line 471) does not render even when the overall unseen badge shows count > 0 for the same orders. Both use `alertsSeenAt` gating so they should always agree; if `alertsSeenAt` is being initialised to any string value before the first fetch, the item-level check `created_at > alertsSeenAt` may be false while the count fallback still uses `orders.length`. Consider making both paths identical (e.g., always derive per-item unseen from the same computed set that feeds unseenAlertCount).

Manually verify that dragging the vendor-sound-volume-slider updates the % display AND writes vendor_sound_volume to localStorage. Automated Radix thumb interaction is flaky; this is functional QA only.
critical_code_review_comments: VendorDashboard.js: unseenAlertCount and the per-item `unseen` boolean use logically identical guards but return divergent results in observed testing (badge=2 vs 0 red dots). Consider computing a single `unseenIds = new Set(recentAlerts.filter(...).map(o=>o.id))` and using it for both the header badge and per-item indicator to eliminate any drift.

VendorDashboard.js sound settings: saveSoundVolume is only invoked on slider onValueChange, so the initial default (70%) is never written to localStorage — vendor_sound_volume stays null until the merchant drags. That's fine, but ensure the CHIMES/volume playback code path also falls back to a sane default if the key is null (do not treat null as 0% or Infinity).
Login page: two 401s are logged on initial visit to /login before login. Consider making the frontend suppress the /api/auth/me probe on the /login route to keep the console clean.

rca of the issue: No blocking bug. Two minor items reported: (1) per-item red-dot indicator missing while header unseen count is present — likely a small logic inconsistency between the two unseen guards in VendorDashboard.js; (2) volume slider ArrowKey interaction inconclusive under Playwright (Radix Slider thumb focus quirk) — recommend manual verification that saveSoundVolume actually fires + persists to localStorage on drag.
